name: LiveArtX
rootCause: The official wallet of NFT platform LiveArtX was stolen, and several reserved NFTs were sold. According to MistTrack analysis, the LiveArtX attacker (0x5f78...A920) has transferred 7.3 ETH and 22.39 WETH to Bitkeep, then exchanged it for USDT and transferred it to a new address (0x871e...A575).

descriptions.text: The official wallet of NFT platform LiveArtX was stolen, and several reserved NFTs were sold. According to MistTrack analysis, the LiveArtX attacker (0x5f78...A920) has transferred 7.3 ETH and 22.39 WETH to Bitkeep, then exchanged it for USDT and transferred it to a new address (0x871e...A575).

On 16 October 2022, a compromised private key allowed an attacker to steal 197 NFTs from LiveArtX’s treasury wallet on Ethereum. The attacker quickly sold the NFTs below floor price, causing severe market impact. The estimated loss is $37,000,$39,000. LiveArtX responded by freezing stolen NFTs, upgrading contracts, and offering buyer compensation. Compromise of the private key for LiveArtX's treasury wallet, combined with a lack of wallet segregation, absence of a multisig scheme, and poor operational controls over key distribution.
